sources.entry: Everything you need to know about DNS

summary.title: DNS Learning Center | nslookup.io
summary.one_liner: This index page links to a broad set of DNS guides covering DNS concepts, record types, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), security, and troubleshooting.
takeaways: DNS basics: stub resolvers, zones, root zone, delegation, and recursive vs authoritative servers.
What each common DNS record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, SRV, PTR) is used for.
How email DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, BIMI) work together for authentication and spam prevention.
Guides on DNS security (DNSSEC, cache poisoning), monitoring, and troubleshooting common errors.
summary.summary: This is a hub page from nslookup.io listing many short articles about DNS. Topics are grouped into DNS concepts, record types, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS), domain registration, security (DNSSEC, cache poisoning, certificate transparency), and troubleshooting such as slow lookups and NXDOMAIN errors. The page itself contains only titles and one-line descriptions; the details live in the linked articles. Several entries are notes about DNS behavior, such as the claim that DNS propagation does not exist.
